scripts.features:
KAIOD v4.0 — Ultimate Edition
🔗 Web: getkaiod.github.io

⚡ What is KAIOD?
KAIOD is a modern glassmorphism UI Roblox script built for chaos. Kill players, drag them, launch them into the void — all with a clean, animated interface.

📌 How To Use
Get a tool from the shop first (any random item works).

Paste the script and execute.

Type a player name or random into the target box.

Pick your action and have fun.

🎯 Core Features
Kill — Can kill players. Select by name or random.

Target ESP — Highlights your target with a live distance tag.

Dual Sliders — Adjustable Speed (0.5x – 3.0x) and Power (1.0x – 5.0x) multipliers.

Player Dropdown — Instantly pick from a list of players.

PageDown keybind — Toggle the GUI anytime.

💥 Action Menu
🖐️ Drag — Left click to drag the target, [Q] to stop.

❄️ Freeze — Locks the target in place. (Currently patched — doesn't work.)

🚀 Launch — Sends the target flying upward.

🌀 Spin — Spins the target around rapidly.

🌍 Earthquake — Shakes the target across the map.

🎲 Toss — Hurls the target to a random location.

🕳️ Blackhole — Pulls the target toward you.

⚡ Super Fling — Extreme fling. Bypasses anti-fling.

⚰️ Bring — Teleports the target directly to you.

🔨 Slam — Slams the target into the ground repeatedly.

⚡ Electro Jitter — Violent random jittering.

🕳️ Sinkhole Trap — Slowly sinks the target underground.

💫 Orbit Shield — Orbits the target around your position.

📍 Click TP — Press, then click anywhere on the map to teleport the target there.

🌪️ Tornado — Spirals the target upward.

🔀 Version Switch
The GUI has a Version Button in the header.

Base version is v3.9 (Physics Mode).

Press the v3.9 button → you switch to v4.0 (Touch + CFrame Mode).

Press again to switch back.

Each version uses a different movement/attack system — try both to see which works better for your game.

⚠️ Notes
Freeze is patched — don't bother.

Super Fling is designed to bypass anti-fling.

If you find a bug, please report it. Feedback helps improve the script.

scripts.features:
Core ESP (Page 1)
Master ESP Switch: A primary toggle used to activate or disable all visual overlay effects within the game.

Names Display: A feature that displays target player usernames above their character.

Distance Tracker: A tracker feature that displays the exact measured distance (in studs [Xs]) you are from other players.

Text Size Adjustment: A feature that cycles through multiple font scaling multipliers to alter overlay text size.

Outline Transparency Slide: An adjustment slider that alters the level of transparency of the player highlight outlines.

Customizable Hide Key: A feature that lets you bind a custom keyboard key (default: RightShift) to the action of toggling the menu UI visibility.

Visuals & Limits (Page 2)
Look Direction Tracker: A feature that displays a rotating directional indicator ($\Delta$) on top of players' heads to indicate what direction they are facing.

Arrow Size Scaler: A fine-tuning option that alters the physical size scale of the look-direction indicator.

Update Refresh Rate: An options menu that lets you select how often the ESP should update its positional information (range: $0.05$s - $1.0$s).

Distance Limiter: A distance limiter that prevents targets from appearing in-view if you are further than a certain amount of studs away from them.

Proximity & Predate (Page 3)
Proximity Alert System: A proximity detection system that displays proximity alerts (in red text) when players enter a proximity alert range.

Dynamic Proximity Text Size: A toggleable feature that enables specific font size scaling to be applied if/when a player enters the proximity alert range.

Predate Target Lock: A target lock feature that locks the ESP target to only one player (from a list) while ignoring distance limiters and proximity limiters.

Spectate & Utilities (Page 4)
Proxy Spectate Mode: A spectate mode that smoothly transitions your camera to the target player's character without disrupting your ability to control your character.

Live Proximity Counter: A counter that displays how many players are within your proximity alert range at a given time.

Customizable Menu Title: A click-interactive option that lets you click the centered title box on the very top of your menu to rename your script interface.

Management ToolsPreset Save Slots: Three slots (1, 2, 3) that let you save, apply, or clear custom configurations of your script settings.

Built-in Interactive Guide: An interactive guide panel that is built into your UI system that explains how each feature works.

local function waitForAnimate(char)
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		local a = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if a and a:FindFirstChild("idle") and a:FindFirstChild("run") and a:FindFirstChild("walk") then
			return a
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return nil
end

local function setAnim(animObj, id)
	if animObj and id then
		animObj.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
	end
end

local function stopAllTracks(hum)
	if not hum then return end
	for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
	end
end

local function ensureAnim(folder, name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local a = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not a then
		a = Instance.new("Animation")
		a.Name = name
		a.Parent = folder
	end
	return a
end

local function ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, n)
	if not idleFolder then return end
	n = n or 2
	for i=1,n do
		ensureAnim(idleFolder, "Animation" .. i)
	end
end

local function pick(pack, ...)
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local k = select(i, ...)
		local v = pack[k]
		if v ~= nil then return v end
	end
	return nil
end

local function applyGoldGlowEffect(textLabel)
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) -- Altın Sarısı
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.2
	stroke.Parent = textLabel

	-- Parlama Döngüsü (Pulsing Glow)
	spawn(function()
		while textLabel and textLabel.Parent do
			local tween1 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Transparency = 0.6, Thickness = 1})
			tween1:Play()
			tween1.Completed:Wait()
			local tween2 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Transparency = 0.1, Thickness = 2.5})
			tween2:Play()
			tween2.Completed:Wait()
		end
	end)

-- APPLY PACK
local ATTR_LAST = "AnimPack_Last"
local applying = false

local function applyPack(packName)
	if applying then return false end
	applying = true

	local pack = PACKS[packName]
	if not pack then
		warn("Unknown pack:", packName)
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local animate = waitForAnimate(char)
	if not animate then
		warn("Animate not found")
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	stopAllTracks(hum)

	local runObj   = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("run"),   "RunAnim")
	local walkObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("walk"),  "WalkAnim")
	local jumpObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("jump"),  "JumpAnim")
	local fallObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("fall"),  "FallAnim")
	local climbObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("climb"), "ClimbAnim")
	local swimObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swim"),     "Swim")
	local swimIdleObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swimidle"), "SwimIdle")
	local idleFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("idle")

	setAnim(walkObj,  pick(pack, "WalkAnim", "Walk"))
	setAnim(runObj,   pick(pack, "RunAnim", "Run"))
	setAnim(jumpObj,  pick(pack, "JumpAnim", "Jump"))
	setAnim(fallObj,  pick(pack, "FallAnim", "Fall"))
	setAnim(climbObj, pick(pack, "ClimbAnim", "Climb"))

	setAnim(swimObj,      pick(pack, "Swim"))
	setAnim(swimIdleObj,  pick(pack, "SwimIdle") or pick(pack, "Swim"))

	if idleFolder then
		local a1 = pick(pack, "Animation1")
		local a2 = pick(pack, "Animation2")

		if a1 or a2 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, 2)
			local id1 = a1 or a2
			local id2 = a2 or a1 or id1
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), id1)
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), id2)
		elseif pack.Idle and #pack.Idle > 0 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, math.max(2, #pack.Idle))
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), pack.Idle[1])
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), pack.Idle[2] or pack.Idle[1])
			for i = 3, #pack.Idle do
				local a = idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation" .. i)
				if a then setAnim(a, pack.Idle[i]) end
			end
		end
	end

	animate.Disabled = true
	task.wait(0.06)
	animate.Disabled = false

	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			task.wait(0.03)
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end)
	end

	pcall(function() player:SetAttribute(ATTR_LAST, packName) end)

	applying = false
	return true
end

-- SWILL Anti-Menu v5.0 – Xeno Edition + ESC Block
-- (c) Swill Way, 2026

local Players              = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService           = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService         = game:GetService("TweenService")
local VirtualInputManager  = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local GuiService           = game:GetService("GuiService")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local ZONE_SIZE  = 90
local PUSH_FORCE = 350
local COOLDOWN   = 1.0

-- ===== ДВИЖЕНИЕ КУРСОРА =====
local function moveCursor(dx, dy)
    if mousemoverel then
        if pcall(mousemoverel, dx, dy) then return true end
    end
    if Input and Input.MouseMoveRel then
        if pcall(function() Input.MouseMoveRel(dx, dy) end) then return true end
    end
    if pcall(function()
        local c = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(Vector2.new(c.X+dx, c.Y+dy), false, game)
    end) then return true end
    local mouse = player:GetMouse()
    if mouse and mouse.MoveRelative then
        if pcall(function() mouse:MoveRelative(dx, dy) end) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function pushFromCorner()
    local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local dir = Vector2.new(cursor.X, cursor.Y)
    if dir.Magnitude < 1 then dir = Vector2.new(1, 1) end
    dir = dir.Unit
    local target = Vector2.new(dir.X * PUSH_FORCE, dir.Y * PUSH_FORCE)
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    target = Vector2.new(math.clamp(target.X,150,vp.X-20), math.clamp(target.Y,150,vp.Y-20))
    local dx = target.X - cursor.X
    local dy = target.Y - cursor.Y
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        moveCursor(dx, dy)
        task.wait()
    end
    return true
end

-- ===== НАДПИСЬ "НЕТ" =====
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SWILL_AntiMenu"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
gui.Parent = playerGui

local noLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
noLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 160)
noLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225, 0.5, -80)
noLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
noLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
noLabel.Text = "НЕТ"
noLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
noLabel.TextScaled = true
noLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
noLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
noLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
noLabel.Visible = false
noLabel.ZIndex = 100
noLabel.Parent = gui

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
stroke.Thickness = 5
stroke.Parent = noLabel

local lastTriggered = 0
local function showNo()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastTriggered < COOLDOWN then return end
    lastTriggered = now
    noLabel.Visible = true
    noLabel.TextTransparency = 0
    noLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    noLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    noLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225+math.random(-20,20), 0.5, -80+math.random(-20,20))
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.8)
        local tw = TweenService:Create(noLabel,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {TextTransparency=1, TextStrokeTransparency=1, BackgroundTransparency=1})
        tw:Play(); tw.Completed:Wait(); noLabel.Visible = false
    end)
end

-- ===== ОСНОВНОЙ ЦИКЛ =====
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if cursor.X <= ZONE_SIZE and cursor.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
        if pushFromCorner() then showNo() end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.01) do
        local cursor = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        if cursor.X <= ZONE_SIZE and cursor.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
            pushFromCorner()
        end
    end
end)

-- ===== КЛИКИ =====
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local pos = input.Position
        if pos.X <= ZONE_SIZE and pos.Y <= ZONE_SIZE then
            pushFromCorner(); showNo()
        end
    end
end)

-- ===== ESC → ЗАКРЫТИЕ ROBLOX МЕНЮ =====
local menuBlockEnabled = true

GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
    if not menuBlockEnabled then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.01)
        pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(false) end)
    end)
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        if not menuBlockEnabled then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.02)
            pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(false) end)
            task.wait(0.05)
            pcall(function()
                if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true,  Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("ContextActionService"):BindActionAtPriority(
        "SWILL_BlockESC",
        function(_, state)
            if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
                return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
            end
            return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
        end,
        false, 9999, Enum.KeyCode.Escape
    )
end)

_G.SWILL_ToggleMenuBlock = function(state)
    menuBlockEnabled = state
    print("[SWILL] Menu block: " .. (state and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

print("[SWILL] Anti-Menu v5.0 активен! ESC заблокирован.")
